Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
957 AM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON...

.REST OF TODAY...W winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves
1 ft. 
.TONIGHT...SW winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming W after midnight. Gusts
up to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 25 kt...becoming W
5 kt after midnight. Waves 3 ft... subsiding to 1 ft after midnight.
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.WED...S winds around 5 kt...becoming E after midnight. Waves 1 ft
or less. 
.THU...E winds 15 to 20 kt...becoming N 25 to 30 kt after midnight.
Waves 1 to 2 ft...building to 3 ft. Rain likely.
